title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Mystic Lake Casino Hotel, Prior Lake | 2019
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Mystic Lake Casino Hotel in Prior Lake, Minnesota, USA, on 22 August 2019.

It was the 27th show of the 14th All-Starr Band’s tour of Asia and North America, which lasted for 34 dates between March and September 2019.

Starr had previously performed at the Mystic Lake Casino Hotel on 14 July 2008 and 25 July 2010. He returned there on 1 October 2023.

The 14th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, piano
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
